about.title: About killBottleneck
about.description: killBottleneck is a fair-code tool for goal maps, projects and tasks. For an ordinary user or company it works like open source — no strings: download it, run it, modify it, use it commercially. You just may not resell it as a hosted service.
about.youtubeDesc: tutorials, news and AI experiments from the authors

externalContacts.title: External contacts
externalContacts.description: People outside the system — accountants, suppliers. They have no account, receive no notifications and know nothing about this; it is purely your internal deadline tracking.
externalContacts.emailHint: The e-mail is just a note for you — the system never sends anything to it.
externalContacts.privateHint: Only you can see it. On a shared map others see just “External contact” without the name.
externalContacts.deleteConfirm: Delete contact “{{name}}”? Existing assignments stay and show “External contact” instead of the name.
